# Vue Bits (license notice)

`components/Style/GlitchText.vue` is adapted from the `GlitchText` text animation of
[Vue Bits](https://vue-bits.dev) by David Haz — source
<https://github.com/DavidHDev/vue-bits> (`src/content/TextAnimations/GlitchText/GlitchText.vue`,
commit `3766ebeeed37ec35bce29f001b6d101c7b17da35`).

The original is Tailwind-based; the adaptation rewrites it in scoped SCSS and adds
periodic bursts, theme colors, reduced-motion handling and screen-reader-silent copies.
